newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine 42-day t-bill rate at 15.770 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippine 42-day t-bill rate at 15.770 pct.

text.p: The Philippine 42-day treasury bill rate fell to 15.770 percent from 17.283 last week, the Bureau of Treasury said on Tuesday.
The Treasury said the rate on the 35-day bill fell to 15.617 percent from 17.558.
Banks and financial institutions gave tenders worth 6.538 billion pesos for the 35-day bills of which 5.038 billion were rejected.
Tenders worth 5.923 billion pesos were received for the 42-day bills of which 4.423 billion were rejected.
